text.title: Three-Roads Siege
text.body: Seeing their perimeter breached, three massive Iron Pact siege columns converge on Three-Roads Watch to sever Vance's rear supply line. Hold the central redoubt beside Warden Tessa, break all three columns, then counter-march north to raze their staging reserve.
text.obj.0: Repel the three converging Iron Pact siege columns
text.obj.1: Counterattack and raze the Northern Staging Reserve
text.msg.1: Iron Pact columns are closing along the north, west, and east roads! Hold Three-Roads Watch—if they cut Vance's supply line, the army inside the caldera is trapped!
text.msg.2: All three siege columns are broken! Pivot north at the double and raze their staging camp before they can rally!
text.msg.3: The Northern Staging Reserve collapses in ash! The Iron Pact's last field reserves are annihilated!
text.win: Three-Roads Watch holds fast and the allied rear is secure for the final descent.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell at Three-Roads Watch.
text.fail.2: Warden Tessa's garrison was overrun and Three-Roads Watch fell.
